items.title: Android Auto's latest Gemini failing keeps asking 'who do you want to call'
items.excerpt: Since Gemini replaced Google Assistant on Android Auto, drivers report the in-car AI repeatedly asking 'who do you want to call' instead of completing call and text voice commands — a visible regression for the car-dashboard assistant.
items.matched_keyword: in-car AI assistant / Gemini Android Auto

items.title: My therapist thinks I should chuck the Amazon Bee Frontier out a window
items.excerpt: The Verge's Optimizer column lives with Amazon's Bee Frontier ambient-listening AI wearable, which records and summarizes conversations and memories — and finds filtering life through AI a lesson in why intelligence can't replace wisdom.

items.title: Peloton teases mystery AI product coming in fall 2027
items.excerpt: Peloton CEO Peter Stern said on an earnings call that a new-category product arriving in fall 2027 will combine 'state-of-the-art software powered by AI' with premium equipment, human instruction and community — and probably won't be a wearable.

items.title: I went hands on with the new Snap Specs — and found out why they could soon be a useful workplace tool
items.excerpt: A hands-on with Snap's untethered sixth-generation Specs AR glasses (£1,999) ahead of their UK launch: a fast voice AI assistant, live speech translation shown as subtitles over the speaker, heads-up Maps and a mid-air keyboard for Google Docs.

items.title: Nvidia's new AI laptop runs nearly 80% slower on Linux — but only when it's plugged in
items.excerpt: Testing by MindStudio found Nvidia's RTX Spark AI laptop ran local AI workloads nearly 80% slower on Linux while on AC power — skipping the charger sped things up — a quirk for anyone buying the machine to run models on-device.

items.title: 다이슨코리아, 로봇·펜슬워시 물 청소기 2종 출시
items.excerpt: 다이슨이 AI 비전 시스템과 UV 라이트를 결합해 눈에 안 보이는 얼룩까지 찾아 닦는 'r3 뉴로비 스팟앤스크럽 UV' 로봇청소기를 국내 출시했다. 흡입력은 기존 대비 65% 높은 3만Pa.

items.title: Someone got an offline LLM running on a 2015 Kindle Paperwhite, even if it's quite slow
items.excerpt: The Inkwell project jailbreaks a 2015 Kindle Paperwhite and runs Quill, a SmolLM2 chatbot via llama.cpp on the e-reader's own processor at about 1.7 words per second — fully offline, nothing leaves the device.

items.title: Someone used Claude Code to reverse-engineer the Apple AirPods 3, and now head-tracking works on Linux
items.excerpt: A Reddit user sent Claude Code agents through iOS framework code to unlock the AirPods 3 gyro sensors on Linux, discovering a different protocol and a Bluetooth packet-size setting; head-tracking now streams at about 200Hz.

items.title: Pudu TOMO S robot mower sharpens its own blades at the dock
items.excerpt: Pudu's first residential robot mower combines 360-degree LiDAR, AI vision and network RTK for wire-free navigation, an AI Mowing Planner that schedules around weather, and a dock that sharpens its rotary blades; on sale early 2027.

items.title: Anker's new window-mounted camera monitors the outside of your home from within it
items.excerpt: Anker's Eufy E10 mounts inside a window to watch outdoors, with color night vision and AI motion detection that distinguishes people, animals and vehicles, plus local recording.
